mapper.select: SELECT S.STUDENT_ID AS STUDENT_ID , S.STUDENT_NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , S.BIRTH_DATE AS BIRTH_DATE , S.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE_NUMBER , E.EDU_NAME AS EDU_NAME , IFNULL(D.DORMITORY_ID, "X") AS DORMITORY_ID FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE S.BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT S.STUDENT_NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , E.EDU_NAME AS EDU_NAME , E.START_DATE AS START_DATE , E.END_DATE AS END_DATE , IFNULL(D.DORMITORY_ID, 'X') AS DORMITORY_ID , D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE S.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE STUDENTS SET ATTEND_YN = 'Y' WHERE STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND ATTEND_YN = 'N' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

UPDATE DORMITORIES SET CURRENT_COUNT = CURRENT_COUNT + 1 WHERE DORMITORY_ID = ( SELECT DORMITORY_ID FROM STUDENTS WHERE DORM_YN = 'Y' AND STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) AND MAX_COUNT > CURRENT_COUNT AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT ATTEND_YN , DORM_YN FROM STUDENTS WHERE STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT D.CURRENT_COUNT , D.MAX_COUNT FROM DORMITORIES D JOIN STUDENTS S ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE S.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND D.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT E.START_DATE , E.END_DATE FROM EDU_INFO E JOIN STUDENTS S ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE S.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT DORMITORY_ID FROM DORMITORIES WHERE MAX_COUNT > CURRENT_COUNT AND DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT J.SUBJECT_NAME , J.CLASSROOM_ID , C.CLASSROOM_NAME , C.FLOOR , C.IMAGE_PATH , C.IMAGE_ID FROM SUBJECT J JOIN STUDENTS S ON S.EDU_ID = J.EDU_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN CLASSROOM C ON C.CLASSROOM_ID = J.CLASSROOM_ID AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE S.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND J.DEL_YN = 'N' AND J.END_YN = 'N' AND J.END_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%y%m%d') >= J.START_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND ATTEND_DATE = CURDATE() AND DEL_YN = 'N'
